business_problem: LPS needed a more unified way to monitor, secure, and scale hybrid environments for enterprise clients because its existing monitoring tools only offered siloed snapshots and could not support proactive incident response, capacity planning, and 24x7 service commitments.
solution_summary: LPS partnered with IBM to redesign its delivery foundation around hybrid infrastructure, AI-driven observability, centralized data governance, and automation. IBM LinuxONE provides the high-performance base for workloads that require strong security and resilience, while IBM Instana delivers full-stack, real-time monitoring across physical, virtual, containerized, and serverless environments. The teams also centralized structured and unstructured information in a secured data lake so operations could combine performance and governance signals, and they added IBM Turbonomic plus AI/ML-driven remediation to optimize resource allocation automatically. Containerization and microservices were adopted to improve scaling flexibility for client environments that span finance, telecom, retail, and public sector use cases. Together, these layers turn monitoring from a reactive point tool into a cross-environment operational system that helps LPS detect issues earlier, reduce downtime, and support new digital experiences such as immersive retail and smart-city services.

solution_components.name: IBM Instana
solution_components.role: Supplies AI-driven full-stack observability, tracing, and root-cause analysis across LPS-managed environments.

solution_components.name: IBM LinuxONE
solution_components.role: Provides the secure, high-performance infrastructure base for hybrid enterprise workloads.

solution_components.name: IBM Turbonomic
solution_components.role: Optimizes resource allocation dynamically so LPS can avoid overprovisioning while keeping performance targets.

data_flow: Telemetry from physical, virtual, containerized, and serverless environments flows into Instana for real-time tracing and alerts, operational and security data is centralized in a secured data lake, and Turbonomic plus automated remediation feeds resource and incident actions back into the hybrid cloud estate.
business_outcome: LPS now resolves issues faster, reduces downtime and infrastructure complexity, and supports more resilient digital services for clients while controlling cost and improving planning across hybrid environments.
